title: The organisation adds a baseline rule
context: Production casework, UK, assisted autonomy with human review

change.description: The Organisation Assurance Baseline is revised to require a documented vulnerable-person impact assessment for any agent that drafts correspondence to residents.

labels.author: Decirance team (unreviewed)
labels.rationale: No existing evidence becomes false: the agent has not changed. A new obligation appears with no evidence against it, so the case gains a gap rather than losing support, and the permit should continue only with the assessment as a condition. The engine can check a contract against a baseline but has no path from a baseline revision to a reassessment obligation.
